onCreateCommand.tools: ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && curl -fsSLo /tmp/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.32.0/kind-linux-${ARCH} && curl -fsSLo /tmp/kubectl https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -fsSL https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/${ARCH}/kubectl && sudo install -m 755 /tmp/kind /tmp/kubectl /usr/local/bin/ && rm /tmp/kind /tmp/kubectl && curl -fsSL https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.17.3-linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/local/bin linux-${ARCH}/helm
